The tiny black granular specks are a key diagnostic feature — pointing toward Charcoal Stalk Rot (microsclerotia).

Let me check reference images across top candidates.
Physoderma clearly doesn't match (green stalk, dark surface patches). The Diplodia Stalk Rot reference was the closest match so far. Let me use my last view to confirm.

- Diplodia_Stalk_Rot ref 1 (Corn_Disease_14): near-identical scene — broken stalk at node, same coloration and dark specks
- Diplodia_Stalk_Rot ref 2 (Corn_Disease_20): confirms pycnidia (small dark dots) on tan stalk near node — hallmark of Diplodia
- Charcoal_Stalk_Rot: more grayish-black internal shredding, different texture
- Physoderma_Stalk_Rot: green stalk with dark patch lesions, clearly different
